pages.title: Records
pages.text: $(bold)DUTY LOG$()$(br)Varga, I., records$(br2)Why I am here: I type well and I read what I type. My last posting ended the week I asked who had approved a form.

I typed the manifest for this room. There is a box for the issuing division and nobody would tell me what goes in it. I left it empty.$(br2)No one has corrected it. In eleven years no one has ever left a form of mine alone.
